objective: Qualified lead lists with evidenced provenance and usable exports

leadgen-desk-setup.expected_when: The routine is due and setup or monthly reconciliation has not been verified for the period.
leadgen-desk-setup.acceptance: ICP exists, doctor ran, routines registered or schedule-commands written, first sample path named.
leadgen-desk-setup.fallback: Init blank ICP from examples, run doctor offline, write blockers for missing home URL.
leadgen-desk-setup.recovery: Refresh doctor and continue unfinished setup steps in the current eligible period.

leadgen-icp-refresh.expected_when: The routine is due and ICP has not been re-tested against evidence this month.
leadgen-icp-refresh.acceptance: A dated note of what changed in config/icp.json or an explicit no-change with evidence paths.
leadgen-icp-refresh.fallback: Score explain on current DB and list disqualifiers dominating the funnel.
leadgen-icp-refresh.recovery: Re-read exports and status; apply only evidenced ICP edits.

leadgen-source-run.expected_when: ICP is configured and READY NOW is below target or sources have new places to cover.
leadgen-source-run.acceptance: Status shows new or merged companies with provenance; caps respected.
leadgen-source-run.fallback: Import data/samples/companies_sample.csv or run one OSM place already in ICP.
leadgen-source-run.recovery: Resume uncrawled or unsourced work within caps.

leadgen-enrich-run.expected_when: Companies exist with crawl_status null or missing contacts.
leadgen-enrich-run.acceptance: Crawl and contact stages advanced; robots.txt honored.
leadgen-enrich-run.fallback: Crawl a small worker count on uncrawled rows only.
leadgen-enrich-run.recovery: Continue uncrawled set; do not raise paid caps.

leadgen-qualify-run.expected_when: Contacts await verify or companies await score.
leadgen-qualify-run.acceptance: Verify and score completed for due rows; invalid/DNC excluded from qualified set.
leadgen-qualify-run.fallback: Local verify provider only; score --explain into state notes.

leadgen-desk-standup.acceptance: brief-latest.md written and brief.deliver attempted; status numbers sourced.
leadgen-desk-standup.fallback: Write brief from last status and runlog only.
leadgen-desk-standup.recovery: Rebuild brief from current DB status.

leadgen-export-run.expected_when: Qualified companies with usable email exist and export is due.
leadgen-export-run.acceptance: CSV and HTML report paths exist under data/exports/ and are named in progress receipt.
leadgen-export-run.fallback: Export with --limit on a small verified slice.

leadgen-push-run.expected_when: Friday period due and an export exists.
leadgen-push-run.acceptance: Dry-run report written; live push only if RELEASES.md names the channel.
leadgen-push-run.fallback: Dry-run only and attach report path to brief inbox.
leadgen-push-run.recovery: Repeat dry-run; never infer release from a prior week.
